Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How quickly will we see results?

We begin by testing creative, offers, and audiences. Timing depends on your business, budget, and sales process; we review progress together and improve based on the data.

Which platforms do you run ads on?

We specialize in Meta, meaning Facebook and Instagram. That's where our clients get the lowest cost per lead and the best return, so that's where we focus all of our energy.

Do you work with our industry?

We work with growing service and ecommerce brands. In our first call, we review your offer, audience, and goals to see whether our approach fits your business.

What if we want to cancel?

No problem. We work month to month with 30 days notice. No long term contracts or cancellation fees. We're confident you'll want to stay, but we don't believe in trapping anyone.

How involved do we need to be?

Very little. We script, film, edit, and launch everything. You show up for the filming day, approve the creatives, and handle the leads or orders that come in.
